# Go Nihon Trip

> Japan travel guide organized by region: sights, festivals, restaurants, shopping, transport, airport-to-city routes, monthly weather and what to wear, and day-by-day itineraries for Tokyo, Osaka/Kyoto/Nara/Kobe, Nagoya, Hiroshima, Shikoku, Fukuoka, Hokkaido and Okinawa. Available in Korean (default, /), English (/en/), Japanese (/ja/), Simplified Chinese (/zh/), Traditional Chinese (/tw/), Thai (/th/), Spanish (/es/) and French (/fr/). Admission fees and hours were compiled from official sources (as of October 2026); weather figures are Japan Meteorological Agency normals (1991–2020).

## Suggested itineraries

- [Japan Itineraries – Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, Fukuoka, Hokkaido & Okinawa](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/): Multi-day itineraries for Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, Nagoya, Hiroshima, Shikoku, Fukuoka, Hokkaido and Okinawa, with day-by-day routes and admission fees.
- [Mt. Fuji & Kawaguchiko day trip – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/fuji-day/): Leave Tokyo early and see the best Mt. Fuji viewpoints in a day.
- [Fukuoka in 2 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/fukuoka-1n2d/): The airport is close to the city, so even a short trip covers Hakata, the Nakasu food stalls and Dazaifu.
- [Fukuoka in 3 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/fukuoka-2n3d/): A close, compact city that's great for short trips, with half a day in Dazaifu and an evening at the yatai.
- [Asahikawa, Biei & Furano in 3 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/furano-2n3d/): Start in the city of the zoo and ramen, then drive through the rolling hills and flower fields of Biei and Furano. July's lavender season is the most popular.
- [Hakodate, 2 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/hakodate-1n2d/): A port-city trip for one of Japan's top three night views and a seafood breakfast at the Morning Market.
- [Hakone hot springs, 2 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/hakone-1n2d/): Spend a night at a ryokan and loop through an art museum, a volcanic valley and a lake cruise.
- [Hiroshima & Miyajima in 2 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/hiroshima-miyajima-1n2d/): Reflect on history at the Peace Park on day one, then head to Miyajima and its torii in the sea.
- [Ishigaki & Taketomi in 3 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/ishigaki-2n3d/): An island-hopping trip from emerald Kabira Bay to Taketomi's water-buffalo carts and the jungle of Iriomote.
- [Itoshima coastal drive, day trip – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/itoshima-day/): 40 minutes by car from Fukuoka: a day along the coast past a torii in the sea and seaside cafés.
- [Osaka, Kyoto & Nara in 5 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/kansai-4n5d/): The classic Kansai route: stay in Osaka, two days in Kyoto and one in Nara.
- [Kobe & Arima Onsen, 2 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/kobe-1n2d/): Kobe's exotic streets and harbor night view, then the mountain onsen town of Arima.
- [Kyoto in 3 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/kyoto-2n3d/): Stay in Kyoto and take Higashiyama, Arashiyama and Fushimi one day at a time.
- [Kyoto day trip from Osaka – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/kyoto-day/): With just one day, link Kyoto's eastern highlights from Fushimi Inari to Gion.
- [Fukuoka, Yufuin & Beppu in 4 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/kyushu-3n4d/): City sightseeing plus Kyushu's two most famous onsen towns, with a night in Yufuin or Beppu.
- [Matsuyama & Dogo Onsen in 2 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/matsuyama-1n2d/): A relaxed trip: the hilltop castle, then a night at historic Dogo Onsen.
- [Miyako Island in 3 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/miyako-2n3d/): Drive across bridges between islands and soak up the famous 'Miyako blue' sea.
- [Nagoya & Inuyama in 3 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/nagoya-2n3d/): Two days in castle-and-museum-rich Nagoya, plus a trip to Inuyama's National Treasure castle.
- [Nara day trip – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/nara-day/): See the deer park, the Great Buddha and the old Naramachi streets on foot in one day.
- [Okinawa in 3 days (by car) – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/okinawa-2n3d/): A short road trip through Naha, the Churaumi Aquarium in the north and the central coast.
- [Okinawa main island in 4 days (by car) – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/okinawa-3n4d/): Loop the island by car: Naha's history and markets, the northern sea and aquarium, and sacred sites in the south.
- [Osaka in 3 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/osaka-2n3d/): One day at Universal Studios Japan, plus Osaka's food and city views.
- [Osaka & Kyoto in 4 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/osaka-kyoto-3n4d/): The most popular Kansai route: stay in Osaka and spend two days in Kyoto.
- [Sapporo & Otaru in 3 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/sapporo-2n3d/): A short combo of central Sapporo and canal-side Otaru, ending with seafood at the morning market.
- [Sapporo & Otaru in 4 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/sapporo-3n4d/): A first Hokkaido trip combining Sapporo with the canal town of Otaru.
- [Hiroshima, Onomichi & Kurashiki in 4 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/setouchi-3n4d/): After Hiroshima and Miyajima, head east to hillside Onomichi and canal-side Kurashiki.
- [Takamatsu, Naoshima & Kotohira in 3 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/takamatsu-naoshima-2n3d/): Based in Takamatsu: a garden day, an art-island day on Naoshima, and a day climbing Konpira's steps.
- [Takayama & Shirakawa-go in 3 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/takayama-shirakawago-2n3d/): Take the Hida express from Nagoya to the mountain town of Takayama and the thatched village of Shirakawa-go.
- [Tokyo in 3 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/tokyo-2n3d/): A short first trip to Tokyo: old Tokyo, the busy west side and Tokyo Station, one day each.
- [Tokyo highlights in 4 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/tokyo-3n4d/): A first-timer's route that splits old and new Tokyo across the days.
- [Tokyo & Mt. Fuji (Kawaguchiko) in 5 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/tokyo-fuji-4n5d/): A Tokyo trip with one night at Lake Kawaguchiko for close-up views of Mt. Fuji.
- [Tokyo, Yokohama & Kamakura in 5 days – Suggested itinerary](https://gonihontrip.com/en/itinerary/tokyo-kamakura-4n5d/): Stay in Tokyo and spend a day each in seaside Kamakura and port city Yokohama.

## Travel preparation

- [Staying Connected in Japan – eSIM, Pocket Wi-Fi, SIM or Roaming](https://gonihontrip.com/en/guide/connect/): Compare ways to get online in Japan: eSIM, pocket Wi-Fi, SIM cards and roaming, with pros, cons and who each suits.
- [Entering Japan – Visas, Visit Japan Web and Banned Items](https://gonihontrip.com/en/guide/entry/): What to check before entering Japan: visas, how to register on Visit Japan Web, banned items like meat, fruit and some medicines, and duty-free allowances.
- [Japanese Etiquette – Onsen, Shrines, Trash, Trains and Restaurants](https://gonihontrip.com/en/guide/etiquette/): How to use an onsen, visit shrines and temples, sort trash, and behave on trains and in restaurants in Japan.
- [Money in Japan – Cash vs. Card, Exchange and ATMs](https://gonihontrip.com/en/guide/money/): How much cash to carry in Japan, how to exchange money and use ATMs, and how to pay by card.
- [When to Visit Japan – Cherry Blossoms, Rainy Season & Autumn Leaves by Region](https://gonihontrip.com/en/guide/season/): Normal cherry blossom, rainy season and autumn leaf dates by region, what to wear each season, and how to avoid typhoons and holiday crowds.

- [Where to Stay in Okinawa – Best Areas, Hotel Picks & Booking Tips](https://gonihontrip.com/en/okinawa/stay/): Pros and cons of the best areas to stay in Okinawa (Naha (around Kokusai-dori), Central (Chatan & Ginowan), North (Onna & Motobu)), hotel picks and what to check before booking.
- [Where to Stay in Osaka – Best Areas, Hotel Picks & Booking Tips](https://gonihontrip.com/en/osaka/stay/): Pros and cons of the best areas to stay in Osaka (Namba & Shinsaibashi, Umeda (Osaka Station), Tennoji & Shinsekai, Around Kyoto Station, Kawaramachi & Gion), hotel picks and what to check before booking.
- [Where to Stay in Shikoku – Best Areas, Hotel Picks & Booking Tips](https://gonihontrip.com/en/shikoku/stay/): Pros and cons of the best areas to stay in Shikoku (Dogo Onsen, Matsuyama Okaido, Around Takamatsu Sta. & port), hotel picks and what to check before booking.
